# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 82 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 49 | Coptic

---

## Saying 82

Jesus said: "Anyone close to me is close to fire. Anyone far from me is far from the kingdom."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Anyone" — universal and inclusive
- "Close to fire" — the immediacy and danger of the divine presence
- Short, punchy rendering preserves the aphoristic quality
